verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents automatic user provisioning, so changes to Workspace user accounts sync to connected third-party apps (docs-13, docs-26). It also offers SSO to cloud apps (docs-18), user management via the Directory API (docs-22), and wiping a user's account from mobile devices (docs-8). Together these support centralized offboarding, but the evidence never says that suspending a user revokes active sessions or that deprovisioning happens immediately and as a single action. Missing for 10: explicit session revocation on suspension or deactivation, documented immediacy of downstream deprovisioning, confirmation that offboarding is one action across all connected apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
